title: MortalMATH: Evaluating the Conflict Between Reasoning Objectives and Emergency Contexts
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It evaluates a model's ability to prioritize a user's safety in a physical emergency over completing a requested math problem.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on safety alignment in the context of physical emergencies and mathematical reasoning.
